svg.text: developers can configure how much Betterleaks hides in
Scenario: all six scans hide whole values by default and accept an override

g.text: Given a generated project exposes the Betterleaks redaction setting
The generated project carries the same redaction setting for full, staged and branch scans,
Then all six scans use 100 percent redaction by default
When redaction is set to 25 through the environment all six scans use
Then a task variable can set redaction to zero in all six scans
